headline: Toyo Denso Co., Ltd. Halts Production After Malware Attack Hits Factory Networks
body: A recent malware attack has forced Toyo Denso Co., Ltd., a key player in the automotive component industry, to temporarily cease operations in multiple factories. Industry experts note the severe disruption, highlighting vulnerabilities in network security within manufacturing environments.
